rule: Make the invite page look like this: Hey, can you make our invite page look like this screenshot? The whole page should be dark, almost black navy, with a blue strip at the top that has our name in soft yellow, and the page title in the same yellow. Under the title, put one rounded card a shade lighter than the background, with the reward amount large and bold in bright green and a short line above and below it. Then add a short numbered list of the 3 steps, and a wide yellow button with rounded corners and dark text at the bottom.
